payload.system: Split a transmission project title into its named endpoints (substations or places). Return at most two names, without voltages, numbers or words like Rebuild/Line/Substation.
payload.prompt:
Title: Grady 230/115kV Relay Modernization
Description: Upgrade protection on 230kV bus, all 115kV buses, and both 230/115kV auto transformers at Grady. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply. Install a 230kV breaker and associated switches on the high side of Grady 230/115kV auto transformer D.
